snippet.title: Pokemon Sword and Shield - Crown Tundra Expansion Pass Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the latest Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield Expansion Pass trailer. The Crown Tundra expansion for Pokemon Sword & Shield will be released on October 22.
